basic_info.main_problem: 我对自己玩黏土模型的热情感到not安,害怕他人的评判,这导致我隐藏这一爱好并为之感到羞愧.
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到这种not安全感和被评判的Fear正在影响我的心理健康,阻碍我Freedom享受爱好,我希望能自在地表达并拥抱我的爱好.
growth_experiences: 约一年前,一位朋友对我制作黏土模型的爱好发表了带有贬损意味的评论,由此我开始感到羞耻与not安全;当时压力水平较高,并逐渐形成'他人会把我的爱好视为幼稚或极客'的看法.随后我越来越倾向于隐藏这一爱好,not再公开参与,甚至在私下进行时也伴随负罪感与羞耻.此后,只要关于黏土模型的念头出现,我就会避免讨论或参与,长期影响情绪与人际.

core_beliefs: Others will look down on me because of my hobbies
Expressing the true self brings judgment and humiliation

special_situations.event: A year ago a friend made disparaging comments about my clay model hobby
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果有人贬低我的爱好,就说明它确实幼稚,do not人也都会那样看我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hides the hobby, reduces sharing work with others, avoids related topics
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will laugh at me, thinking I am a 'geek' or childish

special_situations.event: Whenever thinking of sharing the clay-model hobby with others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我谈起或展示这个爱好,do not人就会认为我奇怪,幼稚或在浪费时间
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Done only in private, actively avoids discussion and self-exposure in social situations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am weird and laugh at me

special_situations.event: When with friends, becomes aware that oneself is concealing this part of life
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not隐藏,关系会受损,他们会看not起我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 继续隐瞒并回避,把注意力Displacement到其他话题
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果他们知道真实的我,就not会接纳我

special_situations.event: Work中感到创造力与热情被not安全感所削弱
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的爱好not被认可,那么我的创作热情也not值得公开
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Maintains basic work performance but suppresses expressive enthusiasm and related creation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的创意not值得被看到,还是do not公开了

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被看见并以真实的兴趣被接纳(Freedom表达自我与创造力)
core_conflict.fear: Fears being mocked, judged, and rejected with damaged relationships
defense_goal: 通过隐藏与回避来Self-protection,降低被外界negate的风险

object_relations.self_representation: A self easily mocked and devalued

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about 'publicly sharing hobbies' in counseling or invited to do reality-testing exercises
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equates openness and self-exposure with being judged and humiliated (transference: projecting past experiences of being devalued onto the current interaction)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious tone, lowering self-exposure; downplaying real feelings, turning to safer topics (such as work), expressing 'I'll think about it more', avoiding being forced; the counselor needs to invite them to gradually elaborate the experience in a low-arousal, empathic, and normalizing manner.

manifestations: 因害怕他人评判而隐藏爱好,Restricted self-expression
Avoids showing true interests in social settings
拥有密友但not yet分享真实not安与重要爱好
outcomes: Emotional alienation and reduced sense of being understood

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Presumes others will see one's hobby as childish or geeky
在not yet获得证据前先行判断他人会嘲笑或轻视自己

positive_force: Having a few close friends as potential support
Stable work performance, with sustained artistic creation ability
主动寻求咨询,具备改变动机与自我Reflection能力
negative_force: High sensitivity to and fear of others' judgment (mind reading, overgeneralization)
Strong sense of shame; tends to conceal and avoid self-exposure
Self-worth excessively dependent on external evaluation(外部验证)

target_behavior.behavior: 在他人面前回避讨论或展示黏土模型爱好,并伴随羞耻与not安全感
antecedent: Thinking about sharing hobbies with others or showing work
Being asked about hobbies when with friends
target_behavior.core_reason: 朋友的贬损言论Reinforcement了对负面评价的Fear与灾难化Anticipation,形成读心术与过度概括的认知偏差,因而以回避来Self-protection
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的刺激(嘲笑,批评,被轻视),降低Anxiety与羞耻的即时体验
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends,情感疏离;Declining creativity and passion;在私下进行时伴随内疚与羞耻,进一步固化回避循环
